purpose: Apply the declared AML render gate to an actual captured interface screen using separately supplied labels with auditable provenance.

decision.degrade: Not assigned by this minimal gate; DEGRADE requires an additional declared policy rather than an invented threshold.

claim_boundary: This contract proves deterministic application of declared labels to a captured interface. It does not prove that attention_cost or restoration_value objectively measure human attention, harm, wellbeing, or restoration; it does not stop a dishonest label author; and project-controlled fixtures are not independent product validation.
